official.deadline_note: The 2025/2026 call for both StudFG scholarships runs from 1 October 2026 to 3 November 2026: the merit scholarship via u:space, the research scholarship by email.
official.status_note: The current call for the 2025/26 study year is open from 1 October 2026 to 3 November 2026 for both the merit scholarship and the research scholarship.
benefits: Merit scholarship awarded on the basis of academic achievement, retrospectively for already completed exams/courses and independent of income
Research scholarship as a one-off sum supporting an unfinished scientific work (Diploma thesis, Master's thesis or dissertation)
Signposting to external funding: grants.at Austrian database, stipendium.at, the Austrian National Union of Students database and the Chambers of Labour portal
eligibility: Merit scholarship: outstanding academic performance, awarded independently of the income of the student or their family
Research scholarship: above-average financial burden (e.g. research travel outside Vienna) and a fundable thesis topic; one application per semester
Applications require the Matrikelnummer; graduates quote it as well
requirements: Merit scholarship: apply via u:space between 1 October 2026 and 3 November 2026
Research scholarship: apply by email between 1 October 2026 and 3 November 2026 - personal applications are not possible
selection_criteria: Merit scholarship: weighted grade average calculated from individual course grades (ECTS-weighted), not overall grades
Research scholarship: pre-decision by the scholarships commission, considering criteria such as an exceptional topic and the applicant's financial burden
coverage: Merit scholarship for already completed exams/courses, granted retrospectively
Research scholarship: a one-off payment to help complete a scientific thesis
application_method: Merit scholarship: online application via u:space
Research scholarship: application by email only to the Office of the Studienpräses
official.application_route: Merit scholarship via u:space; research scholarship via email to the Office of the Studienpräses
official.citizenship_residency: Non-Austrian citizens can be granted equal status under StudFG (detailed information published on the official equality information sheet)
official.international_eligibility: Possible for non-Austrian citizens through equal-status rules under StudFG; needs-based support is handled separately by the Studienbeihilfenbehörde (stipendium.at)
official.research_requirement: Research scholarship requires an unfinished scientific work (Diploma thesis, Master's thesis or dissertation)
official.description: The University of Vienna awards a merit scholarship for outstanding study performance and a research scholarship as a one-off payment supporting an unfinished scientific thesis, both funded by the Federal Ministry and administered by the Office of the Studienpräses, with needs-based support left to the state study grant authority.
official.program_type: University-administered merit and research scholarships under the Studienfoerderungsgesetz (StudFG)

documents - no document list is published on the pages
verification.notes: The English grants-and-scholarships hub confirmed the award types and the 17.09.2026 publication date; the German studienpraeses subpages confirmed the 1 October - 3 November 2026 windows, the u:space and email routes and the selection criteria. No CHF/EUR amounts are published on any official page, so none are asserted.

applicant_utility.summary: Vienna's own scholarships are performance-based, not need-based: the merit scholarship rewards a strong weighted grade average retrospectively via u:space, and the research scholarship is a one-off sum for an unfinished thesis, applied for by email only. Both run from 1 October to 3 November 2026; needs-based support comes separately from the state authority at stipendium.at.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-performing enrolled students (merit scholarship) and students in the final thesis stage with above-average financial burden (research scholarship).
application_readiness_checklist: Merit scholarship: apply in u:space between 1 October and 3 November 2026
Research scholarship: email the Studienpräses office within the same window - personal applications are not accepted
Prepare a cost breakdown and financing plan for the thesis award
If you need need-based aid, apply separately to the Studienbeihilfenbehörde via stipendium.at
common_rejection_risks: Confusing the university's merit scholarships with the state study grant - different offices, different rules
Missing the 1 October - 3 November 2026 window for either award
Applying for the research scholarship without a defensible cost plan and supervisor backing
Expecting an income test to help the merit award - it is explicitly income-independent
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Vienna living costs and tuition fees; the research scholarship is a one-off thesis grant, not a living stipend.
document_audit: Research-scholarship applications must be sent from your u:account email quoting your Matrikelnummer
The merit award is calculated on a weighted grade average built from individual course grades, not from overall grades
alerts: Non-Austrian citizens may qualify through equal-status rules under StudFG - check the official information sheet
Both 2025/26 calls were published on 17 September 2026, so dates can shift year to year
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Merit: u:space application -> Studienpräses decision. Research: email with forms and plans -> scholarships commission -> decision by email.
